name: What features should I consider for accessible laundry room storage?

mainEntity.name: What features should I consider for accessible laundry room storage?

acceptedAnswer.text: When planning accessible laundry room storage, consider solutions that are easy to reach and operate. Pull-down shelving systems bring items within reach without straining. Open shelving or wire racks at appropriate heights can be useful for frequently used items. Drawer units with full-extension glides and D-pull handles are easier to open than standard knobs. Avoid deep, fixed cabinetry that requires excessive reaching or bending. The goal is to maximize storage utility while minimizing physical effort and potential injury.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider pull-down shelving, open shelves at appropriate heights, and drawer units with easy-to-use handles to maximize storage while minimizing physical effort.
